components.main: attention9 heads 1 and 4 complete causal-position response
components.mlp9: complete MLP9 response, whose exact Left/Right/interaction program transferred to v11
components.auxiliary: attention11 heads 1/3 and attention15 head 5 complete causal-position response

background: Weight-defined MLP8 post-cue complement actuation; attention9-15 and MLP9-14 otherwise clamped to their native base responses; MLP15-17 and attention16-17 remain live downstream consumers.
target: The unrestricted MLP8-complement intervention on the same v11 rows.

predictions.sufficient_program: The joint three-component program retains at least 75 percent of unrestricted behavior and Q8 norm on both A panels with cosine at least .95.
predictions.missing_branch: Coverage or directional alignment fails, requiring later MLP corrections or additional attention9 heads before weight compilation.

factorial: All eight component unions are executed; singleton summation is not assumed through nonlinear downstream computation.
fit_policy: zero fit, response extraction screen before literal replacement
